# PrepEve

> PrepEve is an online IELTS coaching company based in India and Canada. It coaches IELTS (Academic and General Training) and French for Canada PR. Classes are taught live online in batches of at most 5 students, with trainer-marked writing and 1-on-1 speaking mock interviews. 15,000+ students trained; rated 4.7 on Google from 300+ reviews.

Key facts:
- Format: live online classes, max 5 students per batch; also 1-on-1 mentorship and a self-paced course.
- Programs and prices (INR, 30-day programs): Self-Paced ₹4,999; Live Coaching ₹14,999; 1-on-1 Mentorship ₹19,999.
- Free options: a free live demo class (level assessed, study plan to keep) and a free 60-minute live IELTS webinar every Saturday and Sunday at 7:00 PM IST.
- Trainers: Sanjita (founder and trainer, Regulated Canadian Immigration Consultant), Lesancy Sharma (master trainer), Khushpreet (trainer).
- French for Canada PR: coaching toward NCLC 7, which can add up to 50 CRS points in Express Entry; 6,000+ students taught French.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 98777 14284 · YouTube @prepeveclasses · https://www.prepeve.com
